name: Captain Eudora
guide_text: With Eudora, hero power every single turn starting from turn 1. This is done by leveling to tavern 2 on turn 3 and leveling to tavern 3 on turn 4. Your first hero power reward should be completed on tavern 3, turn 4. Use your second hero power reward on turn 8, and then stop hero powering from turn 9 onwards.
buddy_guide_text: This buddy is mediocre tempo and zero potential. Buddy up when it costs 3-5 gold for tempo, but don't play into it too hard.
